en-US.description: Work and rest, with wnr now!
en-US.longDescription:
It's a time-management tool for computers.
Work and rest, with wnr now.
en-US.name: wnr
en-US.releaseNotes:
中文部分 | English Message Below

请注意：
- 这是 1.35.0 的修复版：修复了 1.35.0 在 Windows 上打开后没有窗口、无法使用的问题，以及设置窗口无法用右上角关闭按钮关闭的问题。 如果 1.35.0 还在后台运行，请先在任务管理器中结束 wnr.exe 再安装。arm64 安装包只适用于 ARM 处理器的 Windows 设备，普通电脑请使用 x64 安装包。
- 从这个版本起，wnr 需要 Windows 10 或 macOS 13 及以上版本。Windows 7 和 8 用户请继续使用 1.34.0。
- 如果你是Windows 10用户且没有关闭Windows Defender Smartscreen，你有可能需要在打开应用后的Smartscreen拦截框中点击“更多信息”->“仍然允许”来运行wnr。原因很简单：取消这个拦截需要我们花费数百美刀购买证书。
- 如果你是macOS用户，若出现“无法打开应用”警告，请遵照这个教程打开应用，原因同样是因为签名证书太贵，难以负担。此外，若出现 “已损坏，无法打开。 您应该将它移到废纸篓”报错，则请遵照另一个教程打开应用 。可能还应在终端中设置 xattr -cr /Applications/wnr.app。
- 对 32 位系统的支持已经终止，因为几乎已经没有人再下载它们。

更新内容：
- 手动跳过会直接进入下一段，不再弹出「时间到」并等你关掉。想要以前的样子，打开「跳过后弹出确认」。
- 严格全屏可以加一个「紧急退出」：照着输入一串随机字符（不能粘贴）就能结束；开了锁定模式则输入密码。
- 重新设计了使用统计，新手引导、关于、对话框和菜单等界面也做了优化。
- Windows 任务栏缩略图上可以暂停和跳过；任务栏和 Dock 的右键菜单可以直接开始正计时或单纯计时。
- macOS 上的通知又能正常弹出了，每天自动检查更新也恢复了。

下载链接：
1. 蓝奏云高速下载
2. 百度网盘链接备用（密码：i4ad）
3. Scoop (Windows)
scoop bucket add sushi https://github.com/kidonng/sushi
scoop install sushi/wnr

联系我：
如果有任何功能建议或者疑问，请发邮件到scrisqiu@hotmail.com。

English Part

Please Note:
- This is a fix for 1.35.0: wnr 1.35.0 did not open on Windows, and the Settings close button did not work. If 1.35.0 is still running in the background, end wnr.exe in Task Manager before installing. The arm64 installer is only for Windows on ARM devices; use the x64 installer on a regular PC.
- From this version on, wnr needs Windows 10 or macOS 13 or later. On Windows 7 or 8, please stay on 1.34.0.

Tips for Windows Users:
- Please note that if you've turned on Windows Defender Smartscreen, you may need to click [more info] and then [still allow] to run it. The situation is here because we cannot afford to buy a signing certificate which costs [hundreds of dollars].
- Support for 32-bit systems has been discontinued, as almost no one downloads them anymore.

Tip for macOS Users:
- Please note that the macOS version is unsigned, so you may need to follow this guide in order to use.
- If macOS reports wnr as "damaged", please follow this guide to get rid of this. If you are using newest macOS versions, it is reported that terminal script xattr -cr /Applications/wnr.app is also needed.

Updated For:
- Skipping goes straight to the next period instead of showing the time-up dialog and waiting. Turn on "Confirm after skipping" to get the old behaviour back.
- Strict fullscreen can have an emergency exit: type a block of random characters exactly (no pasting) to end the session, or the lock passcode if lock mode is on.
- Statistics is redesigned, and the tour, About window, dialogs and menus are polished too.
- On Windows, the taskbar thumbnail has pause and skip buttons. The taskbar and Dock menus can start a stopwatch or simple countdown directly.
- Notifications show up on macOS again, and the daily update check runs again.

Downloads:
1. GitHub Release here below
2. Also available on Softpedia
3. Scoop (Windows)
scoop bucket add sushi https://github.com/kidonng/sushi
scoop install sushi/wnr

Contact Me:
In case you have any suggestion or question, drop me a line at scrisqiu@hotmail.com.
Roderick Qiu, @RoderickQiu
